records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 (2026-06-23) then no further progress in 6 days; no invite sent, no tickets, and no reply to either outreach ([email:024ec483], [email:96bb6351]). Starter plan, single admin, internal handoff note suggests no owner. Silence after early start lowers odds of self-serve milestone in remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Following up on my note last week — you've got a real project going at Clearwater Systems, which is the hard part. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks to that project is usually the natural next move.

If it would help, I'm happy to take a short call this week and look at how your project is set up with you — or just answer questions by email if that's easier.

Best,
Nadia
